task:
Dyrekcja twojej firmy ma do rozdysponowania budżet na **poprawę samopoczucia pracowników** (staff wellbeing). Poproszono cię o **propozycję** (proposal):

- opisz krótko obecną sytuację i problemy,
- zaproponuj dwa konkretne rozwiązania,
- wyjaśnij, jakie przyniosą korzyści i jak uzasadnić koszty,
- zachęć zarząd do podjęcia decyzji.

Użyj nagłówków i stylu formalnego.
model:
Proposal for improving staff wellbeing

Introduction
The purpose of this proposal is to suggest how the budget allocated to staff wellbeing could be used most effectively. It is based on the results of an anonymous survey completed by 85 employees in September.

Current situation
At present, a considerable number of employees report high levels of stress, largely due to tight deadlines and long hours spent at their desks. Almost half of the respondents said they rarely take a proper lunch break, and many expressed concern about the lack of quiet space in our open-plan office.

Proposed changes
Firstly, I would propose converting the unused meeting room on the second floor into a quiet zone, where staff could work without interruption or simply rest for a few minutes. Secondly, it would be advisable to introduce a weekly yoga or stretching session during working hours, run by a qualified instructor.

Benefits and costs
Not only would these measures reduce stress, but they would also be likely to improve concentration and productivity. Moreover, research suggests that companies investing in wellbeing tend to have lower staff turnover. The initial cost of furnishing the quiet zone would be modest, and it would soon be offset by fewer sick days.

Conclusion
I am confident that these relatively inexpensive changes would make a noticeable difference to both the health and the motivation of our team. I would therefore urge the board to approve them, perhaps initially as a three-month pilot scheme.
checklist: Propozycja ma tytuł i nagłówki sekcji.
Wstęp podaje cel (The purpose of this proposal is to...) i źródło informacji.
Opisuję obecną sytuację rzeczowo, z danymi lub proporcjami.
Proponuję dwa konkretne rozwiązania (I would propose... / It would be advisable to...).
Uzasadniam korzyści i koszty, używając „would” i hedgingu (likely, tend to).
Używam co najmniej jednej konstrukcji C1 (inwersja, subjunctive, nominalizacja).
Zakończenie zachęca do decyzji (I would urge the board to...).
